svg.title: Nokia 7610 — black and ruby red reference-based handset illustration
svg.desc: Photorealistic original 2004 Nokia 7610 based on the user-supplied product photograph: asymmetric black casing, chrome left trim, curved red insert and sculpted diagonal keypad. Blank inactive LCD; decorative artwork, not live device data or a theme preview.

rect.desc: Editable LCD guide only. Keep blank; S60 2nd Edition theme preview is unavailable.
